name: Marine Corps Physical Fitness Test (PFT)

source.document: MCO 6100.13A with Changes 4 and 5 (Tables 2-2, 2-4 and 2-5: scoring for pull-ups, push-ups, plank and the 3-mile run) and MARADMIN 613/25 (combat arms standard)
source.documentDate: Order dated 17 Jan 2018 (Change 4 of 23 Mar 2022, administrative Change 5 of 2025); MARADMIN 613/25 of 18 Dec 2025, in force from 1 Jan 2026. The same minimums appear in a Military.com table updated 2026-09-23

variants.label: Combat arms PMOS (sex-neutral: the male age-normed scales, 210 points in total)

rule.summary: Needs at least 150 points in total (210 for a combat arms PMOS) out of 300, and at least the minimum in each event: a result below an event minimum fails the whole test (MCO 6100.13A).

caveat: Pull-ups score up to 100 points and push-ups up to 70; if you enter both, the higher score counts. Female pull-up minimums are worth 60 points, all others 40. The 5,000-meter row, the altitude tables and the Combat Fitness Test are not included.
